== copyright violations ==

I hope you understand that we '''cannot''' take text and information directly from [[Encyclopaedia WoT]] for our chapter summaries. They have to be written in your own words, in order to be included here and licensed under the [[project:GFDL|GFDL]]. I am having to go through and delete some of your edits because of this, please phrase things in your own words in the future, don't just copy-and-paste someone else's work. -- ''[[User:Nae'blis|nae]]'[[User_talk:Nae'blis|blis]]'' 20:54, 4 October 2006 (UTC)
